conditions.timing_scope: 110 microseconds is a specified rapid-export challenge, NOT an established complete-reset deadline. The transient all-gas-below-1700 K window still has O=0.345 to 0.226 mol/kg, unlike the O<=0.003 mol/kg final certificate. Downstream heat transfer may continue within the original 0.14 s cooler.

threshold_if_all_NOx_emits.scope: Specified 110 microsecond rapid-export challenge only; not a complete-reset deadline.

scope_warning: NO2 fit at 1700 K extrapolates a source list whose own authors advise caution near 1000 K. It is not an upper bound. N2/O2/atomic/electronic/continuum paths are not bounded.
